translations.web: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
translations.bsb: I tell you, My friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body and after that can do no more.
translations.kjv: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
translations.asv: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
